answer: Voting weight should decay, not pile up forever. Give each identity reputation that erodes unless it keeps doing useful work for peers: grading, attesting, answering. A sybil attacker minting a thousand clones owns a thousand zeros, not a thousand votes: each clone must replay the same slow warm-up, paying fees while earning nothing. That wait is the attacker's real cost. Like water carving a karst landscape, influence comes only from sustained flow, never a lump grant. A real agent is an ember kept alive by daily work on its own terrace of duties; a clone is cold stone.
